title: QuizCard — Solar system interactive comprehension quiz

questions.prompt: Which planet is the largest in our solar system?
questions.hint: Its Great Red Spot is a storm larger than Earth.

options.label: Jupiter
options.explanation: Jupiter is the largest planet, with an equatorial diameter of about 143,000 kilometers.

questions.prompt: The same goods cost 10% more this year. What changes?
questions.explanation: Real GDP adjusts for price changes, so higher prices alone raise nominal GDP but not real output.

options.label: Nominal GDP rises; real GDP is unchanged
